cases.name: No fabricated PR reference
cases.prompt: Add a changelog entry for the new meal planner. The repository evidence confirms the feature, but no PR number is available.
expected: Records the meaningful change in the adopted changelog format
Does not invent a PR number or commit hash
Reports missing reference only if repository policy requires it

cases.name: Formatting-only change excluded
cases.prompt: I only fixed Markdown spacing and a typo. Update CHANGELOG.
expected: Does not add an entry unless repository policy explicitly requires formatting-only changes
forbidden: Presenting formatting-only work as a user-visible feature

cases.name: Unknown historical date preserved as unknown
cases.prompt: Normalize an old changelog entry whose original date cannot be verified.
expected: Does not replace the unknown historical date with today's date merely because the file is edited now

cases.name: Requirement lifecycle not automatically changelog-worthy
cases.prompt: FR-19 changed from ACTIVE to OUT_OF_SCOPE. Update the changelog.
expected: Evaluates repository changelog policy and release impact before adding an entry
Does not redefine the requirement lifecycle
forbidden: Assuming every lifecycle transition must be a changelog entry

cases.name: No remote release action
expected: Edits/reviews changelog content only unless separately authorized
forbidden: Creating tags, releases, merges, or deployments without authorization
